q4_pre_envelope_bare_array_accepted.evidence: unwrapV1CasesPayload checks `if (Array.isArray(parsed)) return parsed;` for permanent backward compatibility. test-export-envelope-shapes.js asserts identity equality on bare array.

q5_schema_version_1_roundtrip_lossless.details: Known fields defined in normalizeClinicalCase / normalizeSoapNote round-trip 100% lossless. Unknown/additive fields on case objects are stripped during import by normalizeClinicalCase whitelisting. Envelope metadata (exported_at, case_count) is unpacked and re-stamped fresh on subsequent export.

q6_future_schema_versions_rejected_loudl.evidence: unwrapV1CasesPayload throws userFacing Error explicitly citing schema_version. restoreV2Envelope rejects schema_version !== 2 with structured code REJECTED_UNCHANGED.

q7_malformed_envelopes_rejected_before_m.evidence: In v1, JSON.parse, unwrapV1CasesPayload, checkClinicalInvariants, and findImportHistoryViolations run prior to persistClinicalCases(). In v2, candidate key staging and verification run prior to active staging swap.

q8_partial_or_invalid_input_overwrite_pr.evidence: Protected. Failures abort before storage persistence. In v1 restore mode, structuredClone snapshot rollback restores in-memory state on write fault. In v2 restore, failures result in REJECTED_UNCHANGED with active staging and pointer untouched.

q9_unknown_additive_fields_preserved.details: In v1 import path, normalizeClinicalCase and normalizeSoapNote explicitly construct return objects containing only whitelisted keys, discarding unlisted fields. In v2 storage layer, restoreV2Envelope writes full raw JSON to staging, but runtime UI normalizers strip unknown case fields upon loading.

q10_case_count_validated.details: case_count in schema_version:1 envelope is informational only. unwrapV1CasesPayload verifies Array.isArray(cases) but does not compare cases.length to case_count. In v2/c2b migration plans, counts are computed and cross-checked.

q11_duplicate_case_ids_handled_determini.details: In v1 Merge mode, cases are keyed into a Map by ID resulting in deterministic last-wins adoption (subject to exposure/AVS history prefix validation). In C2b buildMigrationPlan, duplicate case IDs throw an explicit Error. In v2 verifyRuntimeEnvelope, duplicate case IDs push a verification failure and abort restore.

q12_error_messages_phi_safe.evidence: unwrapV1CasesPayload, parseJsonOrThrow, parseFailureDetail, and exportClinicalCases report only byte length and shape error descriptions, never echoing raw input text or patient payload. Enforced by scripts/validate-clinical-store-phi-boundary.js in CI.

q13_v1_v2_routing_ambiguity_or_silent_do.evidence: No ambiguous fallback or silent downgrade exists. exportClinicalCases checks pointer === 'v2' and fails closed if staging is missing/corrupt. importClinicalCases refuses v2 envelopes in v1 mode. unwrapV1CasesPayload explicitly traps schema_version:2 and throws if reached.
